feed_summary: A U.S. court on Monday granted the U.S. government's request to detain a former OpenAI engineer accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at the company's San Francisco office to allegedly steal sensitive secrets. title: Ex-OpenAI Engineer Detained in Spy Device Case as Saudi Royal Contacts Emerge
